# `needless-empty-else`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports an empty else branch.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

A branch with no effect adds nesting and suggests that an omitted behavior may
exist.

## When it fires

It applies when removing the branch preserves the conditional expression's
statement context.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn f(x: u32) void {
    if (x > 3) {
        _ = x;
    } else {}
}
```
